name: ZY AI Action Platform
description: Connect your locally installed ZY AI Action Platform: query enterprise data with natural language, inspect and run automation workflows.
description_zh: 连接本机部署的 ZY AI Action Platform（AI 数据智能操作系统），用自然语言查数、查看并运行自动化工作流与数据源。
description_en: Query data, list/run workflows and inspect datasources on your private ZY AI Action Platform instance via natural language.
examples_zh: 帮我查一下上个月的总销售额是多少
看看平台上都有哪些自动化工作流
运行一遍周报自动生成工作流
列出当前已接入的数据源
examples_en: What was our total sales last month?
List the automation workflows on the platform
Show me the configured data sources
